entry.title: feat: add illustration salvage script
entry.content:
feat: add illustration salvage script

The hub finishes an image even when the client's queuing POST times out,
so a failed word usually has a finished picture waiting. Map those runs
back to their word through the example sentence and drop the PNG where
--resume will find it. Recovered 11 of 100 words in the top-100 run.

entry.title: fix: keep card text readable in dark mode
entry.content:
fix: keep card text readable in dark mode

The card hard-codes light backgrounds but let its body text inherit a
colour. Anki's night mode recolours that text to white and leaves the
white card background alone, so on a phone in dark mode every table cell
rendered white-on-white. Headers survived only because they set a colour
explicitly. Reported on AnkiMobile, iPhone, system dark mode.

Pin the text colours and opt the card out of dark-mode inversion rather
than half-supporting it, since the design is a light paper card.

entry.title: feat: add korean deck generator ported from french-anki-pro
entry.content:
feat: add korean deck generator ported from french-anki-pro

Mirrors the French project so fixes port between the two, with the
language-specific parts rewritten rather than translated:

- frequency list built from the OPUS OpenSubtitles v2024 Korean corpus
  (175M tokens); rows are eojeol, a word plus its attached particle or
  ending, matching the French lists choice to keep cest whole
- keep one-character words, which the French loader drops: many of the
  most frequent Korean words are single syllables
- keep Hangul through filename sanitizing, or every clip collapses onto
  one stem and overwrites itself
- bound eojeol matching with explicit lookarounds, since \b never fires
  between two Hangul syllables and 이 would match inside 이거예요
- card prompt covers romanization, dictionary form, word origin, Hanja,
  attached particle/ending, politeness level, and sound changes

Deck ids differ from the French project so both can share one collection.
